rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as a condition:time interaction and specifies a full (~condition + time + condition:time) versus reduced (~condition + time) negative-binomial LRT with time as a 4-level factor, explicitly warning against substituting per-time-point pairwise tests and noting the limited power of a 3-df term at n=3 — this is design-specific and matches the reference. QC is concrete (library sizes, PCA/hierarchical clustering on VST, sample-name reconciliation of the 25-vs-24 mismatch), though outlier handling stops at 'flagging' without a stated exclusion policy. The low-count filter is deferred to an unspecified 'stated, reproducible threshold (e.g., min count sum or CPM)' rather than committed and justified; normalization is handled inside the model via DESeq2 size factors with a documented median-of-ratios fallback. Multiple testing is BH at a pre-specified FDR < 0.05 with counts of interaction versus time-main-effect genes, but no LFC shrinkage or per-time-point fold-change contrasts are named (only per-cell mean expression), and no reference level for condition/time is stated. Enrichment names plausible collections and correctly uses the filtered gene list as universe, but lacks versions and gene-set size windows; reporting covers method, design, thresholds and design caveats but omits software versions.
